nodes.label: Fault F66.1 — the ruled first task of s66 is already answered in the archive

nodes.label: The diffuse Rydberg orbital destroys its own root
nodes.rationale: The 4d solution exists at it1 and is gone at it2: a 421-point scan of the whole nd=1 window finds zero sign changes of log(nrm), closest approach +0.892 — structural, not a near-miss. The diffuse orbital re-drives its own exchange source; the bracket then walks down and out and bisects a two-root bracket, returning the nd=0 state. Self-consistently, neutral scandium has no 4d channel: the raise is the correct answer delivered through the wrong exception.
